fields.v: No (0): all authors are from Meta and built RACER (on Meta's Confucius), the only tool evaluated; the comparison is against manual human work, not against an external approach or tool
fields.quote: In this work, we build an agentic system that attempts to provide enterprise-wide, end-to-end autonomy for a limited set of code improvement tasks.
fields.why: The only tool evaluated is the authors' own; the manual baseline is not an external approach with a vendor, so the 'Partly' rule (own approach compared with external ones) may not apply, and a comparable case with a non-agent baseline (rayyan-800486834) was scored No.
fields.doubt: Os autores (Meta) criaram o RACER, a única ferramenta avaliada. A base de comparação é trabalho manual humano, não outra ferramenta externa. A regra do Parcial é para comparar a abordagem própria com abordagens externas. Decide se o trabalho manual conta como 'abordagem' (Parcial) ou não (Não); sê coerente com o 800486834, onde puseste Não.
